thread:
Nisha: FYI LumenCare renewal incoming. Procurement asked for split invoicing by project (Onboarding vs Production) and a PO referencing multiple SOWs. They want signatures this week.
Carlos: AE here 94 original was 12mo with onboarding fee up front + monthly service. Procurement wants onboarding billed separately and payment on milestones. They also asked about adding a 30-seat uplift clause contingent on pilot success.
Avery: Finance: split invoices ok but need clear billing entity and vendor code. Milestone billing requires a payment schedule in the contract and a 30% deposit on onboarding. Also need PO number to accept as billing doc.
Linda: Legal: we can accept split billing if contract includes payment waterfall and curator of invoices. For the uplift clause we should make it an Optional Purchase Right, not guaranteed. Also require DPA reference and keep data transfer rinse minimal.
Carlos: Customer is hybrid US/EU, procurement will route EU invoices to their EU entity. They provided an EU VAT ID but procurement wants Redwood to host logs in US only 94 they asked for the inverse residency clause.
Nisha: We flagged residency as non-negotiable in that direction. We can offer log retention in EU region for EU-entity invoices only with additional SOC review. Need legal to approve that redline.
Linda: Proposed redline: "Logs and telemetry for EU billing entity customers will be stored in EU region only; production model weights and inference remain on US-hosted clusters." Also add cross-border transfer clause and minimal liability carveout.
Avery: RevOps note: discount tiers rely on committed ARR. If they want month-to-month with milestone onboarding we need to lock committed seats or apply a contingency uplift fee. Recommend 10% discount for signed commitment to 12mo equivalent, otherwise list price.
Nisha: Action items: Carlos -> confirm which billing entity will sign the PO and ask procurement to include the pilot uplift note (ETA 3h). Linda -> prepare the redline and upload to envelope (ETA 5h). Avery -> confirm vendor code and draft invoice schedule (ETA EOD). I'll coordinate with enablement for go-live risk if payments shift to final milestone.
Carlos: Pinged procurement for PO holder and pilot text. They replied PO will be by COB and confirmed EU VAT ID.
OpsBot: DocuSign envelope created: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/LMN123 (status: created).
Linda: Uploaded redline and requested legal signoff. Note: we must not accept deferred final payment longer than 45 days post-go-live.
Avery: Vendor code 4301 available. Draft invoice schedule: 30% onboarding at signing, 30% at pilot completion, remaining monthly over 10 months. I'll post the PDF.
Nisha: Great. If PO + EU entity confirmed today we can finalize amendment and push to DocuSign. Watch for procurement signature authority on PO. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
